Name: SMALLBASE_AND_SPOT_ATTACH_POINT_ST
Description: The places on the map where a site (small base, boss, event) can be placed. Each row is one attach point: its map tile, entity ID, default site and which SmallBaseAndSpotDefine site types may go there. The pattern results (LotResultSmallBaseAndSpot) name these rows by ID.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 332 rows.

Fields.Name: Map ID: AA
Fields.Description: AA part of the map tile mAA_BB_CC_00 the attach point is on. The field map is always m60; retail 60 on every row.

Fields.Name: Map ID: BB
Fields.Description: BB part of the map tile the attach point is on. Must match the tile for the point to be used.

Fields.Name: Map ID: CC
Fields.Description: CC part of the map tile the attach point is on. Must match the tile for the point to be used.

Fields.Name: Map ID: DD (Map Variant)
Fields.Description: Map variant of the tile this attach point belongs to: it is matched against the tens digit of the map block's DD part (m60_BB_CC_D0) when the game collects the attach points of a loaded tile. 0: the normal map; retail 1-5 on the Mountaintop, Crater, Rotted Woods, Great Hollow and Shrouded City versions.

Fields.Name: Required Pattern Modifier
Fields.Description: Not read by the game: input of the offline map-pattern lottery. In retail results the attach point is used only in patterns that have this modifier (0: none). Retail: 11-15 (Shifting Earth maps), 180 (Night Horde), 700-708 (starting areas).

Fields.Name: Excluded Pattern Modifier 1
Fields.Description: Not read by the game: input of the offline map-pattern lottery. In retail results the attach point is never used in a pattern that has this modifier (0: none). Retail: 11-15, the Shifting Earth maps that cover the spot.

Fields.Name: Excluded Pattern Modifier 2
Fields.Description: Not read by the game: input of the offline map-pattern lottery. In retail results the attach point is (almost) never used in a pattern that has this modifier (0: none). Retail: 700-708 on major bases (the starting area that replaces them), 11-15 on a few rows.

Fields.Name: Attachment Point Entity ID
Fields.Description: Entity ID of the attach point in that tile's map (e.g. 1042372999), where the placed site's map is attached.

Fields.Name: Default Small Base ID
Fields.Description: SmallBaseMapVariationParam ID of the site normally standing here. When the placed site uses this map, the site is treated as the default one and no site type is looked up for it. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Allow Site Type 100
Fields.Description: Set: a site of SmallBaseAndSpotDefine row 100 (retail: Ruins) may stand here. On Great Hollow patterns the same flag means row 1100, on the second pattern set row 2100. Used to find which site type a placed site belongs to.
